title: dnt rules (overlay) file
description: A TOML file of rules for features, in <data>/library/overlays/. Each feature names an entity and adds resources, toggles, effects and spells to characters that have it. Formulas use the stat names of the sheet (level, prof, mod.str, class.<class>.level, class table columns, …) and functions such as scale(), if(), max(), level('Class'), toggle('key').

id.description: `<type>:<reference>`, e.g. `classFeature:Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1`, `feat:Tough|XPHB`, `race:Dwarf|XPHB`. A `*` part names every entity with anything there: `classFeature:Ability Score Improvement|*|*|*`.

name.description: Shown as the origin of effects; the entity's name if missing.

class.description: For a class's feature: the class these rules are for (`Shaman|WoW`), when another class than the one the feature names has it.

short_rest_regain.description: Formula: how many come back on a short rest (for long-rest resources).

target.description: A stat: ac, speed, hp.max, initiative, save.dex, skill.stealth, attack.bonus, attack.damage, attack.melee.damage, attack.ranged.bonus, attack.one_handed.damage, attack.strength.damage, attack.heavy.damage, attack.unarmed.damage, attack.offhand.full_mod, rider.<key>, resource.<key>.max, …

when.description: Formula that must be true, e.g. `toggle('raging')`.

origin.description: Shown in breakdowns; for riders, `Name: when it applies`.

choose.description: A choice of spells: the data format's filter, e.g. `level=0|class=Wizard`.

count.description: How many to choose (1 if missing).

grant.description: Always prepared, known, or cast without a slot.

uses.description: A free cast: casts per long rest (at will if missing).

resource.description: A free cast paid with a resource, by its name, e.g. `Soul Fragment`.

cost.description: What a cast takes of the resource (1 if missing).

attack.description: How it changes attacks with the weapons `weapons` picks.

weapons.description: Formula: which weapons, by their facts: weapon.melee, weapon.ranged, weapon.simple, weapon.martial, weapon.name, weapon.both_hands and the properties (weapon.light, weapon.heavy, weapon.finesse, weapon.two_handed, weapon.versatile, weapon.thrown, weapon.reach, weapon.ammunition, weapon.loading). All weapons if missing.

kind.description: What those weapons are called (`monk weapon`): the player marks weapons in or out of the kind.

ability.description: Formula: the ability modifier for their attack and damage rolls, e.g. `max(mod.str, mod.dex)`.

die.description: Formula: a damage die used instead of the weapon's when it is better.

dice_min.description: Each damage die counts at least this.

reroll.description: Damage dice of this or less are rolled again, once.

offhand.description: Weapons it lets attack off hand, besides Light weapons in both hands.

main.description: Formula: what the main hand's weapon must be (main.light, main.melee, … as for weapon.*).

off.description: Formula: what the off hand's weapon must be (weapon.*).

note.description: What it needs, shown when the weapons do not have it.

choice.description: Choices it asks for when gained (a class's or subclass's feature).

key.description: What it is called, and what the character file keeps it under; the rule's name if missing.

pick.description: Ability scores to increase (or a feat instead), a feat, skills to gain Expertise in, or weapons to master.

count.description: Formula (expertise, weapon_mastery): how many the feature gives in all at a class level; the class table's columns are at that level.

feats.description: ability_increase, feat: the feat categories offered (the data's, e.g. G, EB); feats without a category always are.
